  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees`

  (SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(ID AS STRING), ', ' ORDER BY ID) FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees`
     WHERE (ARRAY_LENGTH(account_type) = 0 OR 'D' IN UNNEST(account_type))
       AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(aci) = 0 OR 'E' IN UNNEST(aci))) AS wildcard_ids,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees`
     WHERE (ARRAY_LENGTH(account_type) = 0 OR 'D' IN UNNEST(account_type))
       AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(aci) = 0 OR 'E' IN UNNEST(aci))) AS wildcard_count
